newsitem.title: PERU: Peru negotiator arrives for talks with rebels.
newsitem.headline: Peru negotiator arrives for talks with rebels.

text.p: Peruvian government negotiator Domingo Palermo arrived Friday at the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where he was expected to hold talks with Marxist rebels holding 72 hostages.
Palermo was expected to hold a second round of face-to-face talks with the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) second-in-command, Rolly Rojas, later in the day.
The first formal meeting on Tuesday between Palermo and Rojas produced a pledge for further talks but little more apparent progress towards a peaceful solution.

As on Tuesday, a guarantors' commission made up of officials of the Red Cross, the Vatican and the Canadian government will oversee the talks at a specially rented two-floor house 150 feet (50 metres) from the Japanese residence.
The three guarantors and a Japanese government observer walked into the building minutes after Palermo arrived.
Rojas was expected to be brought by car to the building.
